prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your goals, budget and industry. Do you mean best for enterprise-level personalization and analytics, best for creative campaigns that use generative AI, best for small‑business automation, or something else?

To help quickly, tell me:
- Your company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Budget range (monthly / project)
- Primary goal (lead gen, personalization, content automation, ad optimization, CX/chatbots, data/analytics)
- Any industry constraints (healthcare, finance, regulated, ecommerce, etc.)

If you want a quick starting point, here are two paths and examples:

1) Large agencies with established AI practices (good if you want scale, integrations and enterprise-grade tech)
- Accenture Song / Accenture Interactive — strong in AI-powered CX, analytics and systems integration.
- Deloitte Digital / Deloitte AI practice — wide enterprise consulting + data engineering + marketing automation.
- Publicis Sapient / Publicis Groupe — creative + data science + ad tech; strong for omnichannel personalization.
- R/GA and VaynerMedia — creative agencies with growing AI and data-science teams for campaign optimization and generative content.

2) Smaller / specialist AI-first agencies and vendors (good for faster experimentation, focused products)
- Boutique LA firms vary rapidly; specialists focus on LLM-driven content generation, ad optimization, personalization engines, or chatbot/CX. I can shortlist local boutiques if you give me the requirements above.

How I recommend evaluating agencies
- Proven case studies and measurable KPIs (lift in conversion, CAC, ARR)
- Clear description of their AI stack (models, vendors, on‑prem vs cloud), data handling and privacy/security
- Ability to integrate with your martech (CRM, CDP, ad platforms)
- Transparency about what is automated vs human-reviewed
- Speed of iteration and scope for pilot projects
- Pricing model and clear ROI expectations

Next step
Tell me the four items above (company size, budget, goal, industry) and I’ll return a tailored shortlist of 3–5 LA agencies (or one enterprise + two boutiques) with recommended pilot scopes and questions to ask each. If you prefer, I can also draft an RFP template.
